source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, I reviewed the BOM and have a few questions:

1\. All capacitors (C1-C18) are missing LCSC part numbers — these are needed for JLCPCB assembly. Can you add them? 2. R7 (1kΩ) and R8 (100Ω) are not in the original spec — what are these for? 3. R10 and R11 (0Ω jumpers) are also not in the spec — what is their purpose?

Thanks

execution.observed_behavior: The reviewed power-board BOM lacks LCSC part numbers for capacitors C1-C18 and contains resistors and jumpers not accounted for by the original specification.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, makes sense, I need bit more time to review schematic and pcb. After that you can update the BOM.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: As for R6, I don't know why it's in bom

execution.observed_behavior: The power-board BOM contains R6 without a known design justification.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, I agree, maybe we shouldnt complicate too much, there are 2 boards remaining. So if BOM is finished please send me the latest version and I will send remaining boards docs.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: In the first picture, 1u and 0.1u have the same part number

execution.observed_behavior: The BOM assigns the same part number to capacitors with different 1uF and 0.1uF values.
